description: An aerial image, likely from Earth Observation (EO) data, depicting a landscape in the Bavarian Forest, Germany. A prominent bright yellow arrow points to a distinct area of forest exhibiting damage from bark-beetle infestation. This damaged forest appears in greenish-blue colours, contrasting with the surrounding areas which show predominantly reddish-brown and darker tones, representing healthy forest or other land cover types in this false-colour composite. According to the associated documentation, this colour scheme (greenish to bluish instead of red/brown) is a key identifier for damaged forest areas in EO data. The image is credited to M. Probeck.
